name: alibi-demo-cable-corridors
comment: APPROXIMATE, SCHEMATIC. Hand-made straight segments between published landing points (Wikipedia and operator pages: Elering/Fingrid, Gasgrid/Elering, Cinia, Elisa/Telia). Real routes bend and are not published to this accuracy; uncertainty_km is the half-width of the buffer we test against. Only the main Gulf of Finland links, not a complete cable register. Not for navigation.

properties.name: Estlink 1 (power)
properties.source: Wikipedia 'Estlink'; landing points Harku (EE) and Espoo (FI). Approximate, schematic.

properties.name: Estlink 2 (power)
properties.source: Wikipedia 'Estlink'; landing points Anttila, Porvoo (FI) and Puessi (EE). Middle vertex placed at the crossing position published in the Eagle S technical report (about 59.95 N 26.10 E), so the line passes where the report says the cable is. Approximate, schematic.

properties.name: Balticconnector (gas pipeline)
properties.source: Wikipedia 'Balticconnector'; landing points Inkoo (FI) and Paldiski (EE). Approximate, schematic.

properties.name: Balticconnector telecom cable
properties.source: Runs roughly parallel to the gas pipeline (Elisa/Cinia reports of the 2023 damage); drawn about 1 km east of it. Approximate, schematic.

properties.name: C-Lion1 (telecom, Helsinki to Rostock)
properties.source: Cinia public route description; Gulf of Finland part only, a coarse polyline from Vuosaari (Helsinki) westward. Approximate, schematic.

properties.name: Finland-Estonia telecom cables (FEC family, Helsinki to Tallinn)
properties.source: Operator descriptions (Elisa, Telia); a single straight segment stands in for several parallel cables. Approximate, schematic.
